reason: Offline physical-attempt audit found repeated exhausted CLI HTTP429 errors. The prior collector retried them 3 times per component instead of stopping globally.
changes: Treat Codex error envelopes saying exceeded retry limit with HTTP429 as an immediate global capacity stop; ordinary OpenRouter429 still uses bounded backoff.
Reclassify all legacy no-answer exhausted CLI429 records as nonfinal transport streams, preserving each exact request/response and the pre-reclassification gzip.

Exclude provisional outcome rows whose final components are now nonfinal; retain original ledger lines and list affected rows. Existing observed answers, correct/wrong labels and reading rules are unchanged.
result_retirement_identity: SHA-256 of each exact provisional ledger row. It remains retired even if a later successful response uses the same full-request cache key; a newly collected outcome has a new row signature.
